dataset.description: Synthetic personal and project memories for a heuristic local retrieval-quality gate; contains no user-derived data.
dataset.distractor_policy: For each query, manually select one accessible memory from the same permitted scope or pool that is topically unrelated to the expected answer; distractors are neutral relevance controls, not adversarial near-duplicates.

scope_of_claim: single synthetic retrieval corpus; heuristic product gate, not a universal benchmark
